'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Mike D'Ambroise DS ISB Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Mike D'Ambroise]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Handwritten (sheet Mick). Obj ISB Operations / Empire's Sinister Agents. L15 Tatooine EPA as written (expansion TBD). R41 Call Recon → Tactical Re-Call (uncertain). See notes/batch8_notes.py.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[ISB Operations / Empire's Sinister Agents]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
